_note: Blank rate book for any country. Copy to rates_<place>_<year>.json, fill every def the estimate asks for in your currency, put the quote or source in basis. Areas are per sq ft and lengths per running ft (per m² ÷ 10.764, per m ÷ 3.281). 0 = not applicable; null = not known, the estimate stops and lists it if the design needs it.
